$comment: proseCoverage: the tools each CURATED prose surface documents today. Shrink-only —
a tool listed here that disappears from that surface fails the build. Growing a list
is always allowed and needs no edit here (the gate only reads it as a floor).
NOTE the finding this encodes: public/AGENTS.md and public/llms*.txt each document
2 of the 16 registered tools — verify_credential and search_credentials. (A count of
4 appears if you match bare `search` / `verify`, but those hits are the English words
and the REST path `verify-anchor`, not the MCP tools; see mentionRegex.) That is the
same under-advertisement shape as the 2-of-16 discovery-manifest bug that
tests/infra/mcp-manifest-parity.test.ts was written for. Raising these is content work
on a non-T0 surface, not a tooling change.
knownViolations: violations live on main the day this gate landed. A NEW violation —
including the same false claim appearing on one more surface — fails. Never baseline
a claim introduced by your own PR.
